final: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT m.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS group_avg FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY m.zoneref COLLATE BINARY, s.entrystat COLLATE BINARY), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM site_groups), paired AS (SELECT g.entrystat, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_avg AS overall_difference FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), status_groups AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(group_avg) AS status_avg FROM paired GROUP BY entrystat COLLATE BINARY), kept AS (SELECT p.group_avg, p.overall_difference, p.group_avg - a.status_avg AS status_difference FROM paired AS p JOIN status_groups AS a ON p.entrystat = a.entrystat COLLATE BINARY WHERE p.group_avg > a.status_avg) SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS average_group_average, AVG(overall_difference) AS average_difference_from_overall, AVG(status_difference) AS average_difference_from_status FROM kept
